title: Kinetic cut scene
description: A beat-cut kinetic-type sequence (卡点快剪): one full-frame shot per storyboard line on the BPM grid, every cut a hit that punches the camera, shakes, fires a flash, chromatic aberration and a bloom pulse, with motion blur inside each shot (never across a cut). Each line is `<beats> <entrance> <TEXT> [| sub line] [@layout] [#ground] [+layer…] [!]`: entrances slam, type, assemble (particles build the word), mask, flip, stretch, drop, count (rolls the first number), strobe (one word per half beat), none; layouts @center @left @right @top @bottom @bleed (type cropped by the frame) @diagonal @space (small type, empty frame) @split; grounds #dark #light #accent #secondary; motif layers +scope +routes +rings +rays +grid +orbit +bars +tunnel +blobs +marquee +dial +collapse (squash to a line before the next cut); `!` marks the climax (heaviest hit). ' / ' breaks lines. Vary beats (1/2/4/8), use 3+ entrances, no layout more than twice, one light or accent shot, a climax that breaks the system. For intros, launches, brand and data highlights. The last shot holds to the end; cues a sound on every cut.

default: 2 type every frame a poster | half a second each @left +scope
4 count 120 BPM | locked to the grid #accent +bars
4 assemble KINETIC | the climax breaks the system #light +blobs !
shots.description: The storyboard, one shot per line: `<beats> <entrance> <TEXT> [| sub] [@layout] [#ground] [+layer…] [!]` (see the block description).

bpm.description: Tempo of the beat grid the shots are cut on (use the music's: detect_beats_tool).

look.description: How hard hits hit: clean (no resting aberration, soft flash), punchy, wild (big punch, heavy aberration and flash).

shutter_samples.description: Sub-frames averaged per frame for motion blur inside a shot (1 = off; 10+ for very fast moves; renders that many times slower).
